headline: Friday heat dome — lake first, then A/C
lede: Friday, September 4. High near 99°F with brutal heat index. Dawn on Table Rock or Taneycomo is the only comfortable window — then indoor shows, museums, and air-conditioned dining. Verify lake levels and generation before heading out.

featured.title: Big D's BBQ
featured.why: Best ribs in Branson — casual, affordable, and a local favorite that hits the spot after a hot morning on the water. Cool indoor seating.

plan.title: Lake before the burn
plan.detail: Table Rock or Taneycomo early — cooler water, fewer boats. Check USACE gage and SWPA generation schedule. Carry extra water.

plan.title: Indoor matinee or museum
plan.detail: Sight & Sound, Legends in Concert, or a 76 Strip museum. Real A/C when the heat index spikes past 100°.

plan.title: Dinner then a show
plan.detail: Big D's BBQ or Lake House, then confirm tonight's board. Theatres stay cool late.

indoor.name: Sight & Sound Theatres
indoor.detail: David or current production — climate-controlled biblical spectacular with live animals. Verify exact Friday times at box office.

indoor.name: Titanic Museum Attraction
indoor.detail: Cool, immersive two-hour experience on the 76. Strong for families when it's 99° outside.

indoor.name: WonderWorks Branson
indoor.detail: Upside-down hands-on museum — perfect air-conditioned afternoon for kids and adults.
